children: SPCX and Tesla formed special committees to assess a possible merger. Any deal requires committee, board and shareholder approval; Elon Musk is excluded from discussions over conflicts of interest.
SPCX reported Q3 revenue of $14.58 billion, beating the $12.74 billion estimate. Earnings reached $0.35 per share versus $0.12 expected. Revenue rose 161% year over year, led by Super Intelligence.
Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) lifted its 2027 data-center capacity target to about 13 gigawatts. Some 3.6 gigawatts are under construction; power supply remains a challenge.
Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) has applied for U.S. approval to operate up to 1 million Starmind satellites for orbital AI computing. Initial launches are expected in the second half of 2027.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) debuted on June 12 after raising more than $85 billion.
SPCX agreed to buy a turnkey solar-cell production line from SINGULUS for its Texas facility. Valued at over €60 million, delivery is due in H1 2027; plans include capacity above 100 GW.
Dan Ives said SPCX shares may trade at a 20%–25% discount amid political uncertainty over its Texas expansion; the company is likely to negotiate with state officials.
SpaceX (SPCX) may launch Starship’s 15th test flight as early as Nov. 13, aiming to recover both stages at the launch site and deploy 26 next-gen Starlink V3 satellites.
SPCX shares gained 0.5% from Nov. 3 to Nov. 9. They fell about 9% on Nov. 5 amid political-risk concerns and merger rumors, then rebounded nearly 15% through Nov. 9.
Morgan Stanley reaffirmed its overweight rating on SpaceX (SPCX), citing robotics, mesh networks and space infrastructure as growth opportunities beyond AI computing.
